commit_message: Fix ADR0126 Timeline marker event filtering
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0126 Timeline and Sequencer
pr_body:
## Summary

Fixes the Timeline runtime marker-event contract after the runtime hardening pass. Markers without an authored event remain silent, while markers with an event preserve stable asset + semantic document identity in TimelineEvents.

The PR remains Draft while Project Rust, Sequencer, and final validation continue.
